provenance: Original deterministic analytical source definitions; not measured data, image-extracted observations, or scientific-module results

raster.coordinate_convention: Zero-based pixel-center index coordinates; first pixel center is (0,0), SVG positions add 0.5
raster.rasterization: Nearest integer pixel-center paths joined by Bresenham; presentation derivative only, subpixel analytical coordinates remain authoritative

shared_calibration: Each calibration matrix acts on all 15000 source points. Rows sharing a calibration_key share its exact declared mapping. Five transforms do not constitute five independent acquisitions or an uncertainty estimate.
reference_policy: Verify using an independent exact-rational reconstruction from integer c,k,i, not a generator import or this file as computed results. Canonical CSV is float64 with .17g round-trip text; numerical roundoff is not measurement uncertainty.
limitations: No stochastic uncertainty or covariance is estimated
Image rasterization does not define physical calibration uncertainty
Calibration-specific Y can be zero or negative, so log-Y is not universally eligible
Generic Preview calibration/overlay interoperability requires the accepted CORE contract; this generator never impersonates Curve Digitizer
